name: ariadne
description: Agent-driven single-crystal diffraction reduction from Bruker/Rigaku frames to evidence-linked INS/HKL and solve-single-crystal handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent crystallography agent with signed integration and structure-feedback inference.
interface.longDescription: DIALS reduction kernels, registered scientific tools, persistent typed action graphs, real candidate RES/HKL pairing, native CIF validation, and held-out structure feedback. Reconstructed 0.7.0; real experimental end-to-end accuracy requires local validation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $ariadne-reduction to process my Bruker or Rigaku diffraction data, inspect scientific evidence before accepting each stage, and continue through solve-single-crystal when INS/HKL handoff is ready.
